propositions: Define immutable operation/outcome values with provider-neutral contract specifying logical_id, Disposition, FailureScope, ReplaySafety, and DelaySource enums to centralize retry control across nested adapter layers.

Implement a fake-clock retry budget owner in reconciler domain permitting at most three physical invocations and 15,000 ms cumulative sleep with authoritative provider delays as non-shortening lower bounds.

Serialize outcomes to byte-identical compact UTF-8 JSON via canonical_bytes seam; truncate diagnostic messages to 512 Unicode code points after redaction; enforce eight-entry diagnostic overflow sentinel.
After ambiguous write, observe desired primary-store postcondition before replay; return non-replaying commit_unknown with ReplaySafety.forbidden on failed or inconclusive observation.
Reject provider delays exceeding remaining sleep budget by returning retry_not_before without incrementing invocation or request counters.
Use zero-based retry_index producing jitter windows [2s,3s) then [4s,5s) with no third sleep, preserving ADR 0084 additive-jitter formula.
